title: Report a missing item
summary: Phoenix: Report a missing item. Inspect the 404 status.
introduction: put_status returns an updated connection. Pass that value to json. Open GET /missing.
learningObjectives: Report a missing item with Phoenix

blocks.text: Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.

blocks.title: Report a missing item
blocks.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/missing", LessonController, :missing
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def missing(conn, _params), do: conn |> put_status(404) |> json(%{error: "Book not found"})
end

blocks.text: put_status returns a changed connection. The next piped call sends its error map.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Connection functions return a new value; keep using that returned value.
